## Checklist

- [ ] `python -m pytest`, `ruff check .`, and `mypy sqreader` pass
- [ ] `npm run build` passes (only if the web UI changed)
- [ ] Added or updated tests for new logic
- [ ] Follows the no-guess policy (no heuristic attribution)
- [ ] No new runtime dependency (or agreed in an issue first)
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
